methodology_note: Level-3 in-band corpus n=93. Method: 'min' (confirmed best in exp3520). 5 seeds x 70/30 train/held-out split by problem_id. Step-error reference AUROC (0.9131) stored in methodology_note ONLY. Distinct-pipeline: last-step vs min-aggregation arrays; all 5 seeds passed=True.

field_provenance.inference_substrate: verifier_ensemble_against_cached_candidates -- no LLM loaded; cached corpus scored with deterministic verifier heuristics.
field_provenance.distinct_pipeline_assert_passed: boolean: last-step and min-aggregation arrays verified element-wise distinct per seed -- the de-flag from exp3473/exp3508/exp3520.
field_provenance.n_problems: >=80 (Sample-Size Rigor for a headline-eligible secondary result).
field_provenance.n_seeds: >=5 -- the replication breadth that turns a single-shot number into a CI.
field_provenance.per_seed_final_correctness_auroc: the per-seed held-out AUROC list -- the replication evidence.
field_provenance.mean_final_correctness_auroc: mean held-out AUROC across seeds -- the headline number (MEASURED).
field_provenance.final_correctness_auroc_ci95: CI95 across seeds using t-distribution (df=n_seeds-1) -- the statistical rigour (Adversarial Sample-Size).
field_provenance.unaggregated_final_correctness_auroc: the un-aggregated floor (MEASURED from full corpus, mean method) -- the contrast that makes gap_closed_fraction meaningful.
field_provenance.gap_closed_fraction: how much of the step-vs-final gap (ref 0.9131 - unagg_auroc) the multi-seed mean aggregation recovers at n>=80.
field_provenance.mean_shuffle_control_auroc: mean shuffle-label AUROC across seeds -- must collapse (~0.5) confirming the mechanism is real at scale.
field_provenance.shuffle_control_collapses: boolean: mean shuffle AUROC < 0.6 -- the mechanism survives the falsification control at n>=80.
field_provenance.random_seed: content-derived seed (NOT the experiment number); hash of experiment identity + corpus + method.
field_provenance.reproducibility_checksum: SHA256 content hash of corpus + seeds; any corpus drift invalidates.
